f.title: Use a unique subject identification code instead of the name when reporting adverse reactions
f.statement: The subject identification code is a unique identifier the investigator assigns to each subject instead of the name, to protect the subject's identity when reporting adverse reactions to the medicine and other trial data.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Data integrity & records

rows.quote: Идентификациона шифра на испитаникот е единствена ознака која испитувачот ја доделува на секој испитаник наместо име, поради заштита на идентитетот на испитаникот
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept because it sets how subjects are identified in ADR reports; the purpose clause ('при пријавување на несакани реакции') follows after a page break in the capture. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The subject identification code is a unique identifier which the investigator assigns to each subject instead of the name, for the protection of the subject's identity

f.title: Give priority to subject rights and safety and keep risk thresholds under constant supervision
f.statement: In conducting a clinical trial, the rights, safety and interests of subjects take priority over those of science and society. The trial should be planned and conducted to minimise pain, discomfort, fear and any other foreseeable risk to subjects; the risk threshold and degree of distress should be defined and kept under constant supervision.
f.clause: II. Клиничко испитување на лек, Член 3

rows.actor: Applicant for the clinical trial (sponsor; 'подносител на барањето') and investigators
rows.quote: При спроведување на клиничко испитување на лек, правата, безбедноста и интересот на испитаниците се приоритетни во однос на правата, безбедноста и интересот на науката и општеството во целина.
rows.location: II. Клиничко испитување на лек, Член 3
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: In conducting a clinical trial of a medicine, the rights, safety and interests of the subjects take priority over the rights, safety and interests of science and society as a whole.

f.title: Provide necessary health care to subjects with adverse reactions during and after the trial
f.statement: If adverse reactions or serious adverse reactions occur during the clinical trial, the subject should receive the necessary health care during and after the end of the trial.

rows.actor: Applicant for the clinical trial (sponsor; 'подносител на барањето') and principal investigator
rows.quote: Ако во текот на клиничкото испитување на лекот дошло до појава на несакани реакции, односно до сериозни несакани реакции, испитаникот треба да ја добие потребната здравствена заштита во време и после завршување на клиничкото испитување на лекот.
rows.review_note: Review: level follows 'треба' (should). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If adverse reactions or serious adverse reactions have occurred during the clinical trial of the medicine, the subject should receive the necessary health care during and after the end of the clinical trial of the medicine.

f.title: Research team: inform the principal investigator of adverse reactions and needed protective measures
f.statement: Members of the research team should inform the principal investigator of adverse reactions and/or events to the investigational medicine and of the measures needed to protect the subjects' health.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Членовите на истражувачкиот тим треба да го известат главниот испитувач за несаканите реакции и/или настани на лекот кој клинички се испитува и мерките кои е неопходно да се превземат за заштита на здравјето на испитаниците.
rows.review_note: Review: level follows 'треба'. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The members of the research team should inform the principal investigator of the adverse reactions and/or events of the medicine being clinically investigated and the measures which must be taken to protect the health of the subjects.

f.title: Provide appropriate health care to subjects during and after the trial
f.statement: The principal investigator and research team provide the subject with appropriate health care during the trial and after its end if treatment continues or if the disease or condition is a consequence of the trial.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: му обезбедуваат на испитаникот соодветна здравствена заштита за време на траењето на клиничкото испитување на лекот и после завршувањето на клиничкото испитување на лекот ако продолжува лекувањето или ако болеста или состојбата се последица на клиничкото испитување на лекот;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: provide the subject with appropriate health care during the clinical trial of the medicine and after the end of the clinical trial of the medicine if the treatment continues or if the disease or condition is a consequence of the clinical trial of the medicine;

f.title: Keep subject and investigational product codes confidential; break them only in emergencies
f.statement: The principal investigator and research team keep the subject and investigational medicine codes confidential; they may be disclosed only in emergencies related to protecting the subject's health.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: ги чуваат во тајност шифрите на испитаникот и лекот кој се испитува, а кои можат да станат достапни само во итни случаи, кои се поврзани со заштита на здравјето на испитаникот.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: keep confidential the codes of the subject and of the medicine under investigation, which may become available only in emergencies connected with the protection of the subject's health.

f.title: Principal investigator: notify the sponsor to interrupt the trial when subjects face immediate danger
f.statement: In case of immediate danger to a subject, the principal investigator must notify the trial applicant (sponsor) of the interruption of the clinical trial.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: во случај на непосредна опасност за испитаникот да го извести подносителот на барањето на клиничкото испитување на лекот за прекин на клиничкото испитување на лекот; и
rows.review_note: Review: 'е должен' (is obliged) in the chapeau. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: in case of immediate danger to the subject, to notify the applicant of the clinical trial of the medicine of the interruption of the clinical trial of the medicine; and

f.title: Include a safety assessment section in the clinical trial protocol
f.statement: The clinical trial protocol contains, among other elements, the safety assessment.

rows.actor: Applicant for the clinical trial (sponsor; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.review_note: Review: short list item; the chapeau 'Протоколот на клиничкото испитување на лекот содржи:' gives the obligation. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.

f.title: Propose protocol amendments based on pharmacovigilance results where needed
f.statement: On the basis of scientific and technical developments, pharmacovigilance results and other relevant data, the applicant may propose to the Agency changes and additions to the protocol or to the clinical trial authorisation.

rows.actor: Applicant for the clinical trial (sponsor; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.quote: Врз основа на научно-техничкиот развој на струката, резултатите од фармаковигиланцата и други релевантни податоци, подносителот на барањето на клиничкото испитување на
rows.review_note: Review: the sentence continues after a page break ('лекот може да предложи до Агенцијата промени...'); quote is the part before the break. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: On the basis of the scientific and technical development of the profession, the results of pharmacovigilance and other relevant data, the applicant of the clinical trial of

f.title: Notify the Agency of a temporary halt or early termination within 15 days
f.statement: If the clinical trial is interrupted, the applicant must notify the Agency of the temporary halt in North Macedonia or in other countries where it is conducted, and also of early termination in North Macedonia or other countries regardless of the reason, within 15 days of the interruption.

rows.actor: Applicant for the clinical trial (sponsor; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.quote: Подносителот на барањето за клиничко испитување на лекот е должен да ја извести Агенцијата за настаните од став 1 и став 2 на овој член во рок од 15 дена од денот на прекин на клиничкото испитување на лекот (известување за прекин на клиничкото испитување).
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The applicant for the clinical trial of the medicine is obliged to notify the Agency of the events referred to in paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 of this Article within 15 days from the day of the interruption of the clinical trial of the medicine (notification of interruption of the clinical trial).

deadline_rule.clock_start: од денот на прекин на клиничкото испитување на лекот
deadline_rule.applies_to: temporary halt or early termination (Macedonia or other countries)

f.title: Monitor investigational product adverse reactions under the PV reporting rulebook
f.statement: Monitoring of adverse reactions to the investigational medicine follows the act prescribing the manner of reporting, collecting and monitoring adverse reactions to medicines (the pharmacovigilance rulebook).
f.clause: 11. Следење на несаканите дејства на лекот, Член 36

rows.actor: Applicant for the clinical trial (sponsor; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.quote: За следењето на несаканите дејства на лекот што клинички се испитува се применуваат одредбите на актот со кој се пропишува начинот на пријавување, собирање и следење на несаканите дејства на лекот.
rows.location: 11. Следење на несаканите дејства на лекот, Член 36
rows.review_note: Review: cross-reference row; the referenced act is the 2008 PV rulebook (mk-pv-rulebook-2008, Arts 4-8). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For monitoring the adverse effects of the medicine being clinically investigated, the provisions of the act prescribing the manner of reporting, collecting and monitoring adverse effects of medicines apply.

dates.title: North Macedonia clinical trials rulebook (Sl. vesnik 29/2009): enters into force
dates.scope: Clinical trials of medicines in North Macedonia (applications already started continue under the previous rules, Art 37)
dates.quote: Овој правилник влегува во сила осмиот ден од денот на објавувањето во „Службениот весник на Република Македонија”.
dates.quote_en: This rulebook enters into force on the eighth day from the day of publication in the Official Gazette of the Republic of Macedonia.
dates.location: III. Преодни и завршни одредби, Член 39
dates.timing_note: Published in Služben vesnik na RM no. 29 of 27.02.2009; 2009-02-27 + 8 days = 2009-03-07.
